title: A3 portrait hanok double-leaf window / one-board CNC
note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Every part, pocket, corner relief and nesting position in this package is derived from the values below by generate_spec.py. Do not hand-edit design_spec.json.

lattice_pattern_decision.effect: 8 crossings per leaf, 16 total, lattice cell about 35.67 x 80

supersedes.from_codex/…/02_CNC_current: PORTRAIT_DL_R1 - same 2+4 lattice, but the spec coordinates were hand-maintained and duplicated in the validator
supersedes.from_claude/…_one_board_CNC: 1 vertical + 5 horizontal lattice - a different design choice, not compatible with this package

leaf.note: Each leaf must stay a tall portrait panel. The build refuses parameters whose leaf height / width falls below min_height_to_width_ratio, and the validator re-measures the ratio on the saved DXF.

picture.mounting: One sheet fixed on a separate rear backing behind the frame. Never attached to the moving leaves.

hardware_reference.note: Positions only. Not selected products, not production machining.

nesting.algorithm: first-fit-decreasing shelves, scoped per (family, member width)
